search_text: published ZDI-23-1812 ZDI-CAN-20938 BlueZ Phone Book Access Profile Heap-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2023-12-20 CVE-2023-50230 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2023-50230 7.1 AV:A/AC:H/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['BlueZ'] ['BlueZ'] This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of BlueZ. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must connect to a malicious Bluetooth device. The specific flaw exists within the handling of the Phone Book Access profile. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length heap-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root. BlueZ has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. title: BlueZ Phone Book Access Profile Heap-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of BlueZ. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must connect to a malicious Bluetooth device. The specific flaw exists within the handling of the Phone Book Access profile. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length heap-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root.
